GraniteBluff_Text_Npc0.en: The rock is solid. So am I.
GraniteBluff_Text_Npc0.fr: La roche est solide. Moi aussi.

GraniteBluff_Text_Npc1.en: I tried to climb. I tried twice.
GraniteBluff_Text_Npc1.fr: J'ai essayé de grimper. Deux fois.

GraniteBluff_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

GraniteBluff_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
GraniteBluff_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
